description: Get the status of a scheduled SMS request (GET /sms/v2/services/{serviceId}/reservations/{reserveId}/reserve-status): READY|PROCESSING|CANCELED|FAIL|DONE|STALE|SKIP.

reserveId.description: Reservation ID = the requestId returned by a send with reserveTime

serviceId.description: SMS service ID in NRN form (e.g. ncp:sms:kr:1********2:myproject). Defaults to NCLOUD_SENS_SMS_SERVICE_ID / NCLOUD_SENS_SERVICE_ID. Find it with ncloud_sens_list_projects (smsService.serviceId). A 'Forbidden' reply means the project does not have this channel enabled.

name: ncloud_sens_get_sms_reservation_status
